_readme: Which English value each satellite translation was made from. Read by check-translation-freshness.mjs.
DELIBERATELY UNSEEDED AT THE MOMENT IT WAS ADDED, and that is the honest state rather than an oversight.
The information this file wants does not exist anywhere: a generator MAP entry is 'Key': `translation` and
records no source English. Any seed taken today would stamp the assumption that every satellite was
translated from the current neutral, which is FALSE for exactly the seventeen keys that assumption would
certify as clean. Seeding after the translation round makes it a record instead of a guess.
A key with no entry here is one this check makes NO claim about, and it says so on every run.
A key whose entry is the literal string 'unverified' is reported as unverified and never as a pass.
